examples.hanzi: 总统下个月将访问中国。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng xià gè yuè jiāng fǎngwèn Zhōngguó.
examples.english: The president will visit China next month.

examples.hanzi: 这个网站每天有上万人访问。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǎngzhàn měi tiān yǒu shàng wàn rén fǎngwèn.
examples.english: This website is visited by tens of thousands of people every day.

examples.hanzi: 我会设法按时完成这份报告。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì shèfǎ ànshí wánchéng zhè fèn bàogào.
examples.english: I'll try to finish this report on time.

examples.hanzi: 他设法联系上了失散多年的哥哥。
examples.pinyin: Tā shèfǎ liánxì shàng le shīsàn duō nián de gēge.
examples.english: He managed to get in touch with his long-lost brother.

examples.hanzi: 哎呀，我忘了带钥匙！
examples.pinyin: Āiyā, wǒ wàng le dài yàoshi!
examples.english: Oh no, I forgot my keys!

examples.hanzi: 哎呀，你今天这身衣服真好看！
examples.pinyin: Āiyā, nǐ jīntiān zhè shēn yīfu zhēn hǎokàn!
examples.english: Wow, you look great in that outfit today!

examples.hanzi: 他对朋友一向很慷慨。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì péngyou yíxiàng hěn kāngkǎi.
examples.english: He has always been generous to his friends.

examples.hanzi: 校长慷慨激昂地发表了演讲。
examples.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng kāngkǎi jī'áng de fābiǎo le yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: The principal gave an impassioned speech.

examples.hanzi: 在大城市里，很多年轻人迷失了自己。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà chéngshì lǐ, hěn duō niánqīngrén míshī le zìjǐ.
examples.english: In big cities, many young people lose themselves.

examples.hanzi: 小孩在人群中迷失了方向。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎohái zài rénqún zhōng míshī le fāngxiàng.
examples.english: The child lost his way in the crowd.

examples.hanzi: 人体由几十万亿个细胞组成。
examples.pinyin: Réntǐ yóu jǐ shí wàn yì gè xìbāo zǔchéng.
examples.english: The human body is made up of tens of trillions of cells.

examples.hanzi: 这种药可以杀死癌细胞。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào kěyǐ shāsǐ ái xìbāo.
examples.english: This medicine can kill cancer cells.

examples.hanzi: 验尸报告明天才能出来。
examples.pinyin: Yànshī bàogào míngtiān cái néng chūlái.
examples.english: The autopsy report won't be out until tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 警察要求对死者进行验尸。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá yāoqiú duì sǐzhě jìnxíng yànshī.
examples.english: The police asked for an autopsy to be performed on the deceased.

examples.hanzi: 我每晚十一点睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi wǎn shíyī diǎn shuìjiào.
examples.english: I go to bed at eleven every night.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们每晚都要听一个故事才肯睡。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen měi wǎn dōu yào tīng yí gè gùshi cái kěn shuì.
examples.english: The kids won't sleep unless they hear a story every night.

examples.hanzi: 早起慢慢形成了他的习惯。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoqǐ mànmàn xíngchéng le tā de xíguàn.
examples.english: Getting up early gradually became his habit.

examples.hanzi: 云是由小水滴形成的。
examples.pinyin: Yún shì yóu xiǎo shuǐdī xíngchéng de.
examples.english: Clouds are formed from tiny water droplets.

examples.hanzi: 新年即将来临，大家都很期待。
examples.pinyin: Xīnnián jíjiāng láilín, dàjiā dōu hěn qīdài.
examples.english: The New Year is about to arrive and everyone is looking forward to it.

examples.hanzi: 夜幕来临，街上亮起了灯。
examples.pinyin: Yèmù láilín, jiē shàng liàng qǐ le dēng.
examples.english: As night fell, lights came on in the street.

examples.hanzi: 这件事我想尽快了结。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ xiǎng jǐnkuài liǎojié.
examples.english: I want to settle this matter as soon as possible.

examples.hanzi: 他终于了结了多年的心愿。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú liǎojié le duō nián de xīnyuàn.
examples.english: He finally fulfilled a wish he'd had for many years.

examples.hanzi: 你在哪个行业工作？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài nǎge hángyè gōngzuò?
examples.english: What industry do you work in?

examples.hanzi: 这个行业的竞争非常激烈。
examples.pinyin: Zhège hángyè de jìngzhēng fēicháng jīliè.
examples.english: Competition in this industry is fierce.

examples.hanzi: 爷爷年轻的时候去过苏联。
examples.pinyin: Yéye niánqīng de shíhou qù guo Sūlián.
examples.english: Grandpa went to the Soviet Union when he was young.

examples.hanzi: 这位作家出生在苏联时期。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā chūshēng zài Sūlián shíqī.
examples.english: This writer was born during the Soviet era.

examples.hanzi: 每个孩子都有自己的潜力。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè háizi dōu yǒu zìjǐ de qiánlì.
examples.english: Every child has his or her own potential.

examples.hanzi: 这个市场很有潜力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shìchǎng hěn yǒu qiánlì.
examples.english: This market has great potential.

examples.hanzi: 他因为外遇而和妻子离婚了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi wàiyù ér hé qīzi líhūn le.
examples.english: He divorced his wife because of an affair.

examples.hanzi: 这部电视剧讲的是一个家庭因外遇而破裂的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànshìjù jiǎng de shì yí gè jiātíng yīn wàiyù ér pòliè de gùshi.
examples.english: This TV series tells the story of a family broken apart by an affair.

examples.hanzi: 我想点一份水果沙拉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng diǎn yí fèn shuǐguǒ shālā.
examples.english: I'd like to order a fruit salad.

examples.hanzi: 这家餐厅的沙拉酱特别好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de shālājiàng tèbié hǎochī.
examples.english: The salad dressing at this restaurant is especially delicious.

examples.hanzi: “去把窗户关上。”“遵命！”
examples.pinyin: “Qù bǎ chuānghu guān shàng.” “Zūnmìng!”
examples.english: “Go close the window.” “Yes, sir!”

examples.hanzi: 他笑着说：“遵命，老板！”
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàozhe shuō: “Zūnmìng, lǎobǎn!”
examples.english: He said with a smile, “As you wish, boss!”

examples.hanzi: 晚会的主持人讲话很幽默。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnhuì de zhǔchírén jiǎnghuà hěn yōumò.
examples.english: The host of the evening party speaks humorously.

examples.hanzi: 他想当一名广播电台的主持人。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng dāng yì míng guǎngbō diàntái de zhǔchírén.
examples.english: He wants to be a radio presenter.

examples.hanzi: 他突然的举动吓了大家一跳。
examples.pinyin: Tā tūrán de jǔdòng xià le dàjiā yí tiào.
examples.english: His sudden action gave everyone a start.

examples.hanzi: 他这个举动很不礼貌。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège jǔdòng hěn bù lǐmào.
examples.english: This action of his is very impolite.

examples.hanzi: 他在班上考了倒数第三名。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bān shàng kǎo le dàoshǔ dì-sān míng.
examples.english: He came third from the bottom in the class.

examples.hanzi: 火箭发射前，大家开始倒数十秒。
examples.pinyin: Huǒjiàn fāshè qián, dàjiā kāishǐ dàoshǔ shí miǎo.
examples.english: Before the rocket launched, everyone began the ten-second countdown.

examples.hanzi: 费城是美国历史上很重要的城市。
examples.pinyin: Fèichéng shì Měiguó lìshǐ shàng hěn zhòngyào de chéngshì.
examples.english: Philadelphia is a very important city in American history.

examples.hanzi: 我们下个月坐火车去费城。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià gè yuè zuò huǒchē qù Fèichéng.
examples.english: Next month we are taking the train to Philadelphia.

examples.hanzi: 前面的人太高了，我看不到舞台。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn de rén tài gāo le, wǒ kàn bu dào wǔtái.
examples.english: The person in front is too tall; I can't see the stage.

examples.hanzi: 城市里晚上几乎看不到星星。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshì lǐ wǎnshang jīhū kàn bu dào xīngxing.
examples.english: You can hardly see stars at night in the city.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在广场上喂鸽子。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài guǎngchǎng shàng wèi gēzi.
examples.english: The children are feeding pigeons in the square.

examples.hanzi: 爷爷在楼顶养了几只鸽子。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zài lóudǐng yǎng le jǐ zhī gēzi.
examples.english: Grandpa keeps a few pigeons on the roof.

examples.hanzi: 她从小就对戏剧很感兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù duì xìjù hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: She has been interested in drama since childhood.

examples.hanzi: 他后来选择了戏剧专业。
examples.pinyin: Tā hòulái xuǎnzé le xìjù zhuānyè.
examples.english: He later chose to major in drama.

examples.hanzi: 这个少女的笑容很甜。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shàonǚ de xiàoróng hěn tián.
examples.english: This young girl has a sweet smile.

examples.hanzi: 那是一个关于少女和小狗的童话。
examples.pinyin: Nà shì yí gè guānyú shàonǚ hé xiǎo gǒu de tónghuà.
examples.english: That is a fairy tale about a girl and a puppy.

examples.hanzi: 就算你不喜欢，也要试一试。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn nǐ bù xǐhuan, yě yào shì yi shì.
examples.english: Even if you don't like it, you should give it a try.

examples.hanzi: 就算再累，他也坚持跑完了全程。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn zài lèi, tā yě jiānchí pǎo wán le quánchéng.
examples.english: Even though he was tired, he kept going until he finished the whole course.

examples.hanzi: 我们的小队有五个人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de xiǎoduì yǒu wǔ gè rén.
examples.english: Our squad has five people.

examples.hanzi: 老师把全班分成了四个小队。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ quán bān fēnchéng le sì gè xiǎoduì.
examples.english: The teacher divided the whole class into four small teams.

examples.hanzi: 开餐馆需要有营业执照。
examples.pinyin: Kāi cānguǎn xūyào yǒu yíngyè zhízhào.
examples.english: You need a business license to open a restaurant.

examples.hanzi: 他的驾驶执照下个月到期。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiàshǐ zhízhào xià gè yuè dàoqī.
examples.english: His driver's license expires next month.

examples.hanzi: 总裁出门的时候都带着保镖。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngcái chūmén de shíhou dōu dàizhe bǎobiāo.
examples.english: The CEO always takes bodyguards when going out.

examples.hanzi: 他在电影里演了一个保镖。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài diànyǐng lǐ yǎn le yí gè bǎobiāo.
examples.english: He played a bodyguard in the movie.

examples.hanzi: 你可以拨打投诉热线反映问题。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ bōdǎ tóusù rèxiàn fǎnyìng wèntí.
examples.english: You can call the complaint hotline to report the problem.

examples.hanzi: 这个节目开通了听众热线。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiémù kāitōng le tīngzhòng rèxiàn.
examples.english: This program has opened a hotline for listeners.

examples.hanzi: 居民们向政府提出了抗议。
examples.pinyin: Jūmínmen xiàng zhèngfǔ tíchū le kàngyì.
examples.english: The residents lodged a protest with the government.

examples.hanzi: 学生们抗议学校提高学费。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshengmen kàngyì xuéxiào tígāo xuéfèi.
examples.english: The students protested against the school raising tuition.

examples.hanzi: 他的爸爸是一名军人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de bàba shì yì míng jūnrén.
examples.english: His father is a soldier.

examples.hanzi: 军人要遵守严格的纪律。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yào zūnshǒu yángé de jìlǜ.
examples.english: Military personnel must follow strict discipline.

examples.hanzi: 今天是我们结婚五周年。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒmen jiéhūn wǔ zhōunián.
examples.english: Today is our fifth wedding anniversary.

examples.hanzi: 学校举行了建校一百周年庆典。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào jǔxíng le jiànxiào yì bǎi zhōunián qìngdiǎn.
examples.english: The school held a celebration for its hundredth anniversary.

examples.hanzi: 进考场必须带身份证。
examples.pinyin: Jìn kǎochǎng bìxū dài shēnfènzhèng.
examples.english: You must bring your ID card to enter the exam hall.

examples.hanzi: 我的身份证丢了，要去补办。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shēnfènzhèng diū le, yào qù bǔbàn.
examples.english: I lost my ID card and need to get a replacement.

examples.hanzi: 夫妻之间要多沟通。
examples.pinyin: Fūqī zhījiān yào duō gōutōng.
examples.english: Couples should communicate more.

examples.hanzi: 我们需要和对方沟通一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào hé duìfāng gōutōng yíxià.
examples.english: We need to communicate with the other side.

examples.hanzi: 我最喜欢去海边旅游。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan qù hǎibiān lǚyóu.
examples.english: I like traveling to the seaside the most.

examples.hanzi: 这个城市的旅游业很发达。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de lǚyóuyè hěn fādá.
examples.english: This city's tourism industry is very developed.

examples.hanzi: 新的政策对小企业很有帮助。
examples.pinyin: Xīn de zhèngcè duì xiǎo qǐyè hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
examples.english: The new policy is very helpful to small businesses.

examples.hanzi: 学校的退款政策是什么？
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de tuìkuǎn zhèngcè shì shénme?
examples.english: What is the school's refund policy?

examples.hanzi: 别总是指责别人，先看看自己。
examples.pinyin: Bié zǒngshì zhǐzé biéren, xiān kànkan zìjǐ.
examples.english: Don't always blame others; look at yourself first.

examples.hanzi: 他的做法受到了大家的指责。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zuòfǎ shòudào le dàjiā de zhǐzé.
examples.english: His approach drew criticism from everyone.

examples.hanzi: 她最喜欢看明星八卦新闻。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuì xǐhuan kàn míngxīng bāguà xīnwén.
examples.english: She loves reading celebrity gossip the most.

examples.hanzi: 你怎么这么八卦，别问了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme zhème bāguà, bié wèn le.
examples.english: Why are you so nosy? Stop asking.

examples.hanzi: 这辆车每百公里要用八升汽油。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē měi bǎi gōnglǐ yào yòng bā shēng qìyóu.
examples.english: This car uses eight liters of gasoline per hundred kilometers.

examples.hanzi: 汽油最近又涨价了。
examples.pinyin: Qìyóu zuìjìn yòu zhǎngjià le.
examples.english: Gasoline prices went up again recently.

examples.hanzi: 她躲在房间里偷偷哭泣。
examples.pinyin: Tā duǒ zài fángjiān lǐ tōutōu kūqì.
examples.english: She hid in her room and wept quietly.

examples.hanzi: 听到哭泣声，妈妈马上跑了过去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào kūqì shēng, māma mǎshàng pǎo le guòqù.
examples.english: Hearing the sound of crying, Mom ran over at once.

examples.hanzi: 健康是人生最大的财富。
examples.pinyin: Jiànkāng shì rénshēng zuì dà de cáifù.
examples.english: Health is the greatest wealth in life.

examples.hanzi: 他靠自己的努力创造了大量财富。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào zìjǐ de nǔlì chuàngzào le dàliàng cáifù.
examples.english: He created a great deal of wealth through his own efforts.

examples.hanzi: 想让我白干活？没门！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng ràng wǒ bái gànhuó? Méimén!
examples.english: You want me to work for free? No way!

examples.hanzi: 他想插队？没门，请排好队。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chāduì? Méimén, qǐng pái hǎo duì.
examples.english: He wants to cut in line? Not a chance; please queue up.

examples.hanzi: 星期天我通常在家休息。
examples.pinyin: Xīngqītiān wǒ tōngcháng zài jiā xiūxi.
examples.english: On Sundays I usually rest at home.

examples.hanzi: 下个星期天是我妈妈的生日。
examples.pinyin: Xià gè xīngqītiān shì wǒ māma de shēngrì.
examples.english: Next Sunday is my mom's birthday.

examples.hanzi: 我的侄子特别喜欢踢足球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zhízi tèbié xǐhuan tī zúqiú.
examples.english: My nephew really loves playing football.

examples.hanzi: 周末我带侄子去了动物园。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dài zhízi qù le dòngwùyuán.
examples.english: At the weekend I took my nephew to the zoo.

examples.hanzi: 泰勒每天骑自行车去学校。
examples.pinyin: Tàilè měi tiān qí zìxíngchē qù xuéxiào.
examples.english: Taylor rides a bike to school every day.

examples.hanzi: 我昨天和泰勒一起吃了午饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān hé Tàilè yìqǐ chī le wǔfàn.
examples.english: I had lunch with Taylor yesterday.

examples.hanzi: 做生意要讲良心，不能骗人。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyi yào jiǎng liángxīn, bù néng piàn rén.
examples.english: In business you should have a conscience and not cheat people.

examples.hanzi: 你这样做，良心过得去吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò, liángxīn guò de qù ma?
examples.english: Can you live with yourself doing it this way?

examples.hanzi: 老师教我们跳一种简单的舞步。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiāo wǒmen tiào yì zhǒng jiǎndān de wǔbù.
examples.english: The teacher taught us a simple dance step.

examples.hanzi: 他的舞步很轻快，大家都在看他。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wǔbù hěn qīngkuài, dàjiā dōu zài kàn tā.
examples.english: His dance steps were light and lively, and everyone was watching him.

examples.hanzi: 我永不会忘记你对我的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒng bú huì wàngjì nǐ duì wǒ de bāngzhù.
examples.english: I will never forget the help you gave me.

examples.hanzi: 他们约定永不分离。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yuēdìng yǒng bù fēnlí.
examples.english: They promised never to be apart.

examples.hanzi: 我不能容忍有人在会上玩手机。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù néng róngrěn yǒu rén zài huì shàng wán shǒujī.
examples.english: I can't tolerate people playing with their phones in meetings.

examples.hanzi: 妈妈对孩子的任性已经容忍很久了。
examples.pinyin: Māma duì háizi de rènxìng yǐjīng róngrěn hěn jiǔ le.
examples.english: Mom has put up with her child's willfulness for a long time.
